item.title: Premium Subscriber Hardware Lockout - Device Limit Reached
item.body:
Title: Premium Subscriber Hardware Lockout - Device Limit Reached
 Bug Description
I am a paid Premium subscriber, but my device has been locked out with the error message: "account limit reached on this device."
This happened because I previously logged into multiple free accounts on this same machine to manage my daily token consumption. Now, even though I am logged into my legitimate paid Premium account, the anti-abuse system has flagged my hardware ID and completely blocked my access.
Because the IDE continuously sends background session requests, my 24-hour lockout timer keeps resetting, and I am unable to use the product I pay for.
## Steps to Reproduce

   1. Log into multiple free accounts on one machine over a short period.
   2. Trigger the "Account limit reached" hardware block.
   3. Attempt to log back into the paid Premium account on the same machine.
   4. Error persists and blocks all IDE functions.

Expected Behavior
Paid Premium/Ultra accounts should override or clear the hardware ID restriction so subscribers face no downtime.
Evironment & Account Details

* Trae Account Email: github samuelamissah
* Subscription Plan: Premium
* OS : Windows 11

 Additional Context
I have completely closed the IDE and cleared my local AppData cache folders to stop background requests. Please manually clear the hardware ID/device flag for my premium account so I can resume my development work. Thank you!
